starterCode:
# 英语购物模拟器
sc = 1   # 场景

hide()
t = "进店问候"
a1 = "Can I help you? / What can I do for you?"
a2 = "I'm looking for a T-shirt. / I want to buy a skirt."
tip = "店员问+你回答=对话开始"
if sc == 2:
    t = "询问与试穿"
    a1 = "How much is it? / What size do you have?"
    a2 = "Can I try it on? / Do you have a bigger one?"
    tip = "How much is/are + 单/复数"
if sc == 3:
    t = "付款与礼貌"
    a1 = "I'll take it. / That's too expensive."
    a2 = "Here you are. / Thank you!"
    tip = "即使不买也要说 Thanks anyway"
fill_rect(0, 130, 340, 30, "#16a34a")
write(t, 0, 130, "#fff", 13)
fill_rect(0, 74, 340, 48, "#f0fdf4")
write(a1, 0, 74, "#166534", 10)
fill_rect(0, 12, 340, 60, "#fef3c7")
write(a2, 0, 12, "#b45309", 10)
write("要领：" + tip, -20, -55, "#dc2626", 11)

sections.title: 购物三步
sections.body:
【①进店：Can I help you? → I'm looking for...
【②询问：How much is it? What size? Can I try it on?
【③决定：I'll take it.（买）/ That's too expensive.（嫌贵）
礼貌离店：Thanks anyway.（不买也说谢谢）

sections.title: 问价
sections.body:
【How much is + 单数？How much are + 复数？
How much is this hat? How much are these shoes?
【What's the price of...? 也可以问价】
回答：It's ten dollars. / They're fifty yuan.
讨价还价：Can you make it cheaper? / That's a bit expensive.

sections.title: 尺寸与颜色
sections.body:
【What size do you want? → Size M / Medium】
【Do you have this in blue? → 问问有没有别的颜色】
【It's too small/big. Do you have a bigger/smaller one?】
试穿：Where is the fitting room?（试衣间在哪）
That fits well.（很合身）/ It doesn't fit.（不合身）

examples.q: 你想买一条裤子，店员问 Can I help you?
steps: I'm looking for a pair of pants
或 I want to buy pants
Do you have a bigger one

mistakes: How much is these shoes（复数用are）
不买时不打招呼就走（说Thanks anyway）
